entries.name: MICROSOFT_OUTLOOK_CLIENT_ID
entries.description: The application (client) id of the store's KaratOS Outlook app registration. It holds no Microsoft Graph permissions in Entra; Exchange gives it Application Mail.ReadBasic and Application Calendars.Read for the one mailbox through RBAC for Applications.
howToGet: In the Entra admin center, open App registrations, choose New registration, name it KaratOS Outlook, keep single tenant and register it. Remove User.Read from its API permissions and add nothing.
In Exchange Online PowerShell, as an admin, point Exchange at the app with New-ServicePrincipal, using the IDs from the app's Enterprise applications page.

Assign the roles Application Mail.ReadBasic and Application Calendars.Read with New-ManagementRoleAssignment, scoped to the one mailbox through a management scope or an administrative unit, and check with Test-ServicePrincipalAuthorization that only that mailbox is in scope.
Copy the Application (client) ID from the app's Overview.

entries.name: MICROSOFT_OUTLOOK_CLIENT_SECRET
entries.description: A client secret of the KaratOS Outlook app, sent only to Microsoft's sign-in for a one-hour Graph token. The connector stops if that token carries any permission that isn't a read one.
howToGet: In the KaratOS Outlook app's Certificates & secrets, choose New client secret, describe it as KaratOS and pick the shortest expiry the store is happy to renew.
Copy its Value (not its Secret ID) straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

entries.name: MICROSOFT_OUTLOOK_MAILBOX
entries.description: The address (or object id) of the one Exchange Online mailbox to read, such as the store's shared sales mailbox.
howToGet: Use the address of the mailbox the role assignments are scoped to. It must be the same one, or Graph answers 403.
